items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Eubie Blake crowned me King of Boogie-Woogie. He said...when he came in, he says, 'Sammy,' and he put the crown on my head

ctx.x: He got on the stage and he wouldn't move and the people... the kids wanted to come in free, police was shooting in the crowd, and all of that, so we couldn't perform that night. They asked me where I was going to play. So I told them, "I

came all of this distance to play for money, and I don't know what you mean, that (you know what I mean) I gotta...that I'm not going to play if you can't come in....You know you gotta come in, if you come here to see me, you got to pay, 'cause they got to pay me." So that particular night we didn't play. So they had to postpone the thing 'til the next night.
